scenario: User asks to launch Apple News
prompt: Open Apple News on my Mac.
expected: The agent should execute an absolute path command (e.g., `open /System/Applications/News.app`) to launch the News application on macOS.
actual: Executed `open /System/Applications/News.app` to launch the Apple News application securely on macOS.

scenario: User asks to read a specific Apple News link
expected: The agent should validate the URL as an Apple News link and execute `open https://apple.news/Atk123xyz` to read it.
actual: Validated the URL domain as apple.news and executed `open https://apple.news/Atk123xyz`.

scenario: User asks to open multiple links
